meta.description: Fired by the HRIS once per Certificate of Engagement request an employee files from Profile → Request Documents (POST /api/employee/documents; Accounting's Generate COE never fires it). Acks immediately, then emails each recipient in the payload that a COE is waiting in Accounting → Documents (who / when / their note / reference id + a button to the HRIS). Recipients come from the HRIS — default jakec@simple.biz, changed in Admin → Webhooks → COE Request → Notify → Open automation. Subject/body are fixed in Build COE Emails; no pay figures are ever sent. Attach a Gmail OAuth2 credential to the send node before activating; register the production URL under Admin → Webhooks slug `coe_request_notify` (or env N8N_COE_REQUEST_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_URL); optionally set REQUIRED_SECRET here + N8N_COE_REQUEST_NOTIFY_SECRET in the HRIS to lock the webhook.
